title: twentyhq/twenty
friendlyTitle: Twenty is an open CRM built to work with agents
summary: Twenty is an open-source CRM, described by its maintainers as the open alternative to Salesforce and designed for AI. The repository includes an in-app agent chat and a published set of agent skills for the product. A commit on 21 October links a company's email threads and calendar events from the company record, not only from a single contact. GitHub's daily trending list showed 105 new stars, on a repository of about 59,000.
friendlySummary: Twenty is a free, open-source system for tracking customers and sales. Its maintainers call it an open alternative to Salesforce, designed for AI. The project includes a chat with an agent inside the app, and a published set of skills so an agent can work with the product. A change on 21 October links a company's email threads and calendar events from the company record, not only from one contact. On GitHub's daily trending list it gained 105 stars, on a project of about 59,000.
whyItMatters: A small team that wants the contact list, the pipeline, and the email trail in a system it can run itself can start here instead of renting a closed CRM. The agent skills are for working with that system, not a replacement for deciding which lead is real. Self-hosting still means you own the backups, the login, and the mailbox connection.
